messages:
Priya (Docs): opened a small PR to update Nebula3b model-card: clarified supported-hardware, fixed quant label (use runtime names), and swapped in streaming SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5199

Sam (Runtime): quick request 	6 please use runtime labels (nebula3b-q4_k_m, nebula3b-q8_0, nebula3b-fp16) in the compat table so customers can copy-paste. Also add a one-line note about automatic fp16 fallback when kernels are missing.

Jae (Bench): added two runs in the PR comment: nebula3b-q4_k_m on A10 ~210 tok/s (batch=1, seq=4096), on T4 ~75 tok/s. Recommend publishing a range and attaching the exact bench script.

Olivia (DevEx): updated Python/JS snippets to streaming and added a tiny fallback-detection example using chunk.meta.runtime_fallback. Pushed to the PR; please confirm meta key name.

Sam (Runtime): meta key names look good. One nit: prefer wording "expected throughput" and include test config next to numbers.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check failed  markdown-lint: duplicate-anchor-id in supported-hardware table. See https://ci.redwood.dev/1520

Priya (Docs): fixing anchors and switching internal runtime link to public runtime mapping. Re-requesting review after push.

ci-bot: docs-ci/pr-check passed on second run :white_check_mark:

Priya (Docs): thanks all. I'll merge in ~5m and post a brief note in #docs-release listing the runtime label change and bench caveats.
